name: Unified Deep Image Deraining benchmark
description: A new benchmark dataset and unified evaluation protocol for assessing deep learning algorithms for image deraining.
evaluation_method: PSNR and SSIM (peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity) often reported alongside visual/subjective assessments
typical_sota_score: ≈28–36 dB (PSNR) and 0.85–0.98 (SSIM), depending on test subset
reputation: A targeted benchmark for the image-deraining community that unifies datasets and evaluation protocols to enable more consistent comparisons of deraining methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; performance can vary widely between synthetic and real rain data — risk of benchmark bias toward methods tuned on synthetic rain. Visual quality may not align perfectly with PSNR/SSIM; some saturation on simpler synthetic subsets.
